finding: Emergency bridge commits created through governed need can later fail pre-push historical work admission because attest requires provenance not present in the immutable bridge commit message, and `git:<commit>` provenance is rejected unless the historical commit already includes `ATM-Emergency-Reason`.
expectedBehavior: A governed emergency bridge path should create the required provenance at commit time or provide a first-class post-hoc attestation command that can bind an immutable commit to an external provenance receipt without hidden message-format coupling.
evidenceOrRepro: Plan 3 bridge commits `ec63950aa`, `955afeb78`, and `822462f51` passed delivery validation but pre-push returned `ATM_WRITE_TICKET_HISTORICAL_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED`; `git attest --provenance-ref git:<commit>` failed until a separate `.atm/history/evidence/ATM-GOV-0242.emergency-bridge-provenance.json` file was authored and used for all three attestations.
followUp: Add an emergency-bridge commit/attest contract and a regression that historical admission accepts external provenance receipts without requiring immutable commit-message fields.
